works.body:
Hi! I scrolled through Skeb and noticed how pretty your art style is… I especially  adore the old school feeling in your illustrations. Could you please draw my OC similarly if that is okay? I’d really love her to be drawn by you…!

⇒ Cerise Ethelfreda de Ferella (20）
- Cerise is a brash young lady spoiled by her rich parents.
- A tragedy actress who enjoys playing villainness roles in theatre. She also loves the ojou laugh! (ホホホ)
- Fan of works such as Rose of Versailles and historical romance in general.
- Cerise wears fancy expensive dresses fit for a royal ball, but you can change her outfit and hairstyle to your liking! 
- I apologize if the reference image is hard to interpret. (＞人＜;)

You are free to do anything you’d like with the illustration! Thank you so much for your consideration! ♡
